literal: Great valor they say is fearlessness; when one [adversity] occurs, benevolence is indeed its sharp edge.
translation: They say great valor is fearlessness in battle; but when adversity strikes, benevolence toward others is the very sharp edge of that valor.
modern: போர்க்களத்தில் அஞ்சாமல் நிற்பதே சிறந்த ஆண்மை என்று கூறுவர்; ஆனால், பிறருக்குத் துன்பம் வரும்போது அவர்களுக்கு உதவுவதே அந்த ஆண்மையின் கூர்மையான ஆயுதமாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the true nature of valor (ஆண்மை). While fearlessness (தறுகண்) in the face of danger is considered great valor, it is only half the picture. The poet states that when distress or adversity (ஒன்று உற்றக்கால்) strikes others, showing benevolence and chivalry (ஊராண்மை) is the 'sharp edge' (எஃகு) that perfects and crowns that valor. True strength lies not just in fighting bravely, but in possessing the nobility to help and protect others.
